1	/**
     2	 * Workspace Detail View — Repo Parallelizer GUI.
     3	 *
     4	 * Renders the full detail page for a single workspace inside a project:
     5	 *   - Workspace header: ID, description, breadcrumb link back to the project.
     6	 *   - Repository status table: one row per repository, showing current branch,
     7	 *     a color-coded Git status badge, and an error/loading indicator for repos
     8	 *     with no status data yet.
     9	 *   - Live polling: status badges refresh in-place via a 1-second countdown
    10	 *     interval that triggers a poll every 10 seconds. A visible countdown
    11	 *     label and a "Refresh Now" button provide user control. The interval
    12	 *     is cleared via the cleanup function returned from
    13	 *     `renderWorkspaceDetail`, which the router calls before navigating
    14	 *     away.
    15	 *   - Actions: "Open in VS Code" button (shown only when workspace is
    16	 *     initialised, dynamically added after a successful Setup), "Switch
    17	 *     Branches" navigation button, "Rename Workspace" (disabled for STABLE),
    18	 *     "Delete Workspace" (disabled for STABLE).
    19	 *
    20	 * ## Router integration
    21	 *
    22	 * The view uses the same router-injection pattern as `project-detail.js`:
    23	 * `app.js` calls `setRouter(router)` before `router.start()`. The `_router`
    24	 * variable is null-guarded at every navigation site so the view remains
    25	 * functional in test contexts.
    26	 *
    27	 * ## Cleanup contract
    28	 *
    29	 * `renderWorkspaceDetail` returns a cleanup function. The router's `_render`
    30	 * method already stores and calls any function returned by a view. No changes
    31	 * to `router.js` are needed.
    32	 *
    33	 * @module workspace-detail
    34	 */
    35	
    36	import { api }               from '../api.js';
    37	import { showToast }         from '../components/toast.js';
    38	import { showConfirm }       from '../components/confirm-dialog.js';
    39	import { createStatusBadge } from '../components/status-badge.js';
    40	import { createFormField, validateRequired, WORKSPACE_ID_PATTERN } from '../components/form-helpers.js';
    41	import { normaliseProject, normaliseWorkspace } from '../utils/normalise.js';
    42	
    43	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    44	// Router reference — injected from app.js via setRouter()
    45	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    46	
    47	/** @type {import('../router.js').Router|null} */
    48	let _router = null;
    49	
    50	/**
    51	 * Inject the router instance so workspace-detail can navigate on rename/delete.
    52	 * Called from app.js before the router starts.
    53	 *
    54	 * @param {import('../router.js').Router} router
    55	 */
    56	export function setRouter(router) {
    57	    _router = router;
    58	}
    59	
    60	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    61	// Constants
    62	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    63	
    64	/** Default polling interval in milliseconds (fallback when config fetch fails). */
    65	const DEFAULT_POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 10_000;
    66	
    67	/** The workspace ID that cannot be renamed or deleted. */
    68	const STABLE_WS_ID = 'STABLE';
    69	
    70	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    71	// Normalisation helpers — imported from utils/normalise.js
    72	// extractRepoId and extractRepoName remain local (workspace-detail only).
    73	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    74	
    75	/**
    76	 * Extract a repository's ID from either a plain string or an object.
    77	 * The backend may return Repositories as an array of strings, an array of
    78	 * objects with `Id`/`id`, or an array of objects with `repositoryId`.
    79	 *
    80	 * @param {string|Object} repo
    81	 * @returns {string}
    82	 */
    83	function extractRepoId(repo) {
    84	    if (typeof repo === 'string') return repo;
    85	    return repo.Id || repo.id || repo.RepositoryId || repo.repositoryId || '';
    86	}
    87	
    88	/**
    89	 * Extract a human-readable repository name from a repository entry.
    90	 * Falls back to the ID when no name is available.
    91	 *
    92	 * @param {string|Object} repo
    93	 * @returns {string}
    94	 */
    95	function extractRepoName(repo) {
    96	    if (typeof repo === 'string') return repo;
    97	    return repo.Name || repo.name || extractRepoId(repo);
